questions.explanation: Take \(\frac ar,\ a,\ ar\): \(a^3=27\Rightarrow a=3\). Then \(\frac{3}{r}+3r=10\), so \(r=3\); the largest is \(9\).

questions.prompt: Insert 2 harmonic means between \(1\) and \(\frac{1}{7}\). What is the 2nd mean?
questions.explanation: Insert 2 A.M.s between 1 and 7: \(d=\frac{7-1}{3}=2\), so the 2nd H.M. is \(\frac{1}{5}\).
